mostWorthwhile.text: Examining the channel grains was most worthwhile: the comparison to angular bank grains and the caution about the unknown carrier made the observation feel like real interpretation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Collecting the sediment was functional but uneventful; it simply created the sample.

surprise.text: The pale vein crossing the bands caught my attention; I had expected a clearer surface but not that additional feature.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: collecting, magnifying, breaking and abrading all had understandable purposes, though the latter two were the only gameplay choices offered at their steps.

continue.text: Yes, tentatively: the contrasting grains and crosscutting vein leave me curious about the site's history, although this chapter offered little decision-making beyond choosing the order of the two investigations.
